rca_unanticipated: Positive resolution of MSCI rebalancing sentiment, leading to market strengthening.
Broad-based rally across all sectors, with no sector ending in negative territory.
rca_overestimated: Negative impact of MSCI rebalancing on IHSG.
Negative impact of Rupiah weakening on IHSG.
rca_underestimated: Strength of the market's bullish momentum, leading to a +2.66% gain.
The positive catalyst from the resolution of MSCI rebalancing sentiment.
rca_info_delay: News regarding 'Sentimen MSCI Mereda' and its positive impact on IHSG was published at 10:00:00 GMT (17:00 local time), after the morning brief.
Detailed sector performance and top gainers were reported after market close, indicating the full extent of the rally was not known pre-market.
rca_inverse_correlation: The brief assumed Rupiah weakening (+0.485%) would contribute to a Bearish IHSG, but the IHSG closed Bullish (+2.66%).
The brief anticipated MSCI rebalancing as a factor for weakness, but the resolution of this sentiment ('Sentimen MSCI Mereda') actually led to a strong Bullish IHSG (+2.66%).
lessons: Ketika morning brief memprediksi IHSG Bearish dengan sentimen negatif dari rebalancing MSCI, tetapi sentimen MSCI mereda dan menjadi katalis positif, maka IHSG dapat melonjak Bullish sebesar +2.66%.

Ketika morning brief memprediksi IHSG Bearish dan foreign flow Stagnant dengan Net Buy, tetapi Rupiah melemah 0.485% dan terjadi foreign net sell sebesar Rp 20,76 miliar, maka IHSG tetap dapat menguat Bullish sebesar +2.66% didukung oleh kenaikan seluruh sektor.

Ketika morning brief memprediksi beberapa sektor Bearish atau Neutral, tetapi terjadi penguatan pasar yang luas di mana seluruh sektor berakhir positif, maka IHSG dapat ditutup Bullish sebesar +2.66%, dengan sektor Industri memimpin kenaikan sebesar +4.53%.
summary: The morning brief incorrectly predicted a Bearish IHSG and mixed sector performance, while the market actually saw a strong Bullish rally of +2.66% with all sectors closing positive, despite a weakening Rupiah and foreign net sell, largely due to the positive resolution of MSCI sentiment.
